26th JANUARY 1980 - RUISLIP - VETS A.C. 5M C.C. CHAMPIONSHIPS

mentions.note: 76th Southern vets O.40; 3rd O.40 at Canvey Island, his first medal; former footballer who took up running at 36; TVH relay A team 18.48

mentions.h: XIII COMMONWEALTH GAMES - EDINBURGH - 24 JULY/2 AUGUST 1986

photos.c: Some of the younger Bels. pictured on the Common: Standing (left to right) Barry Everson, Keith Sinclair, Patrick Murphy, Mark Sharp, Nigel Streatfield, Mark Sinclair, Gerard Sexton, Graham Gardner, Alan Perriam, Philip Clay, Peter Morris, Brian Pritchard, John Searle. Kneeling - Mario Pederzolli, Scott Wyld, Simon Pritchard, Paul Thorp, Gerry Howden, Simon Howden, Kevin Sexton, Richard Streatfield.

West side story. 1 mile into the 5¾ and the field is bunched waiting for the break. Following Mark Sinclair and John Gladwin are Bob Lettin(71), Leo Coy, Olly Foote, Laurie O'Hara, Mike Nouch,Eric Crutcher(70),Martin Lake,Simon Williamson(68),and Keith Sinclair(22).
